mapper.insert: INSERT INTO block (title, description, file_key, thumbnail_key, duration, price, category_id, uploader_id, license, source_url, attribution, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{fileKey}, #{thumbnailKey}, #{duration}, #{price}, #{categoryId}, #{uploaderId}, #{license}, #{sourceUrl}, #{attribution}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT b.*, c.id as cat_id, c.name as cat_name, c.color as cat_color, c.icon as cat_icon, u.nickname as uploader_nickname FROM block b LEFT JOIN sound_category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN users u ON b.uploader_id = u.id WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.is_active = true

SELECT b.*, c.id as cat_id, c.name as cat_name, c.color as cat_color, c.icon as cat_icon, u.nickname as uploader_nickname FROM block b LEFT JOIN sound_category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN users u ON b.uploader_id = u.id WHERE b.is_active = true AND b.id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE block SET play_count = play_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE block SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, file_key = #{fileKey}, thumbnail_key = #{thumbnailKey}, duration = #{duration}, price = #{price}, category_id = #{categoryId}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
